description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Language' class within the 'Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Startup' namespace. The class manages language selection and configuration for the catalog section of OpenCart, including setting the default language, overriding language settings, and loading language resources.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents a controller class responsible for handling language selection and configuration in the setup process of the OpenCart catalog.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the language settings by loading available languages, setting default language based on configuration or request, and loading language resources accordingly.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Overrides the default language values after initial setup, based on route, prefix, and language code, and manages loading of language files for specific extensions.
